change.singleResponsibility: Establish a live change-record gate and simplify the API architecture gate without weakening its approved contracts.
change.rollback: Revert the coherent milestone commits in reverse order; generated runtime and catalog return together with the previous gate.

tasks.responsibility: Own the approved design, integration constraints, and manifest contract corrections.
acceptance: Approved design and implementation plan are committed before production changes.

consumers.name: docs/superpowers
consumers.decision: Record the approved design and executable plan before production edits.

tasks.rollback: Revert only the planning documentation commit if the implementation is abandoned.

tasks.responsibility: Supply the approved read-only current-state inventory; it owns no files.
acceptance: The supplied read-only inventory is reflected in the approved design and regression scope.

consumers.name: apps/api/tools/architecture-validator
consumers.decision: Preserve fail-closed exception, intent, diff, diagnostic, and rule guarantees.

tasks.rollback: No tracked repository change belongs to the inventory role.

tasks.responsibility: Implement and verify every tracked change in the Terra thread without using internal agents as routing evidence.
acceptance: Manifest, canonical syntax, catalog, lifecycle, and consumer checks pass their recorded GREEN commands.

consumers.name: scripts/harness/validate-all.sh
consumers.decision: Compose manifest validation with existing harness gates.

consumers.name: .github/workflows/harness.yml
consumers.decision: Validate PR evidence and changed manifest in Harness CI.

consumers.name: .github/workflows/test-api.yml
consumers.decision: Run deterministic image generation twice and keep API gate coverage.

consumers.name: apps/api/tools/xtask
consumers.decision: Expose deterministic image-catalog generate and verify commands.

tasks.rollback: Revert Terra implementation milestones as a coherent set.

tasks.responsibility: Independently review the frozen Terra head only; own no files and do not create a post-review manifest commit.
acceptance: Independent Sol result is recorded in PR body or CI evidence against the exact frozen head SHA.

consumers.name: pull request body
consumers.decision: Store exact SHA approval externally so prose-only edits rerun validation without invalidating a matching approval.

rejectedSimplerAlternatives: Trusting a review without SHA binding

tasks.rollback: A changed head creates a new freeze and independent review; never mutate the frozen manifest after review.

milestones.name: manifest-red
milestones.result: RED observed: the audit-expanded suite failed because the prior implementation selected historical manifests and did not execute the schema.

milestones.name: manifest-green
milestones.result: GREEN: schema is executed, stored-history and PR-diff modes are distinct, ownership is segment-aware, and PR marker evidence is deterministic.

milestones.name: pr-evidence-green
milestones.result: GREEN: one PR marker must bind the changed manifest, all approved task identities, successful test results, current head SHA, and a non-blocking independent Sol result.

milestones.name: process-docs-green
milestones.result: GREEN: concise AGENTS index, process/routing docs, repository skill, lessons, and roadmap boundaries are linked and validated.

commands: docker API harness: cargo test -p architecture-validator --test fixtures --test check --locked
milestones.result: RED include! fixture and GREEN focused suite recorded; cross-file trait identity resolver deleted and replaced by fail-closed local boundary behavior.
